name: Ultimate Light Rail UI Preview
summary: Experimental Light Rail button and build menu alongside the stable core.
description: Experimental GUI-only add-on for Ultimate Light Rail. Adds a Light Rail button between Road and Rail, with native tram depot, public Light Rail track and stations. Uses native GUI recipe replacements generated from the installed game version. Disable this add-on to return to the original UI; the stable core remains separate. No station or vehicle simulation changes. Requires an in-game test and may conflict with other mods replacing the same GUI recipes.
